name: Máncora
summary: Máncora is a sunny surf town on Peru's far north coast, warm when the rest of the coast is grey. Surf or learn to surf, swim with sea turtles at El Ñuro pier, watch humpback whales in season, and eat ceviche straight from the boats.
seasonNote: Sunny all year; humpbacks pass from July to October.
arrival: Fly to Talara or Tumbes (1 hour by road); overnight buses from Lima.
cashTip: Carry soles for taxis and small places; cards work in hotels. Tip about 10 percent.
